dialogues.speaker: Kurash
dialogues.text: Oh, looks like you're a tourist here?

dialogues.speaker: Kurash
dialogues.text: I'm Kurash, I'm not from here, either.

dialogues.speaker: Kurash
dialogues.text: I gained quite a few skills while living in the desert, and I planned to join the Eremites.

dialogues.speaker: Kurash
dialogues.text: But just thinking about running around for my employers gives me a headache... It's better to just find a village and live a life that's fulfilling and leisurely.

dialogues.speaker: Kurash
dialogues.text: Look, even Granny Jehiet chose to retire here!

dialogues.speaker: Kurash
dialogues.text: See you, I hope you'll get to relax here for some time too.

dialogues.speaker: Kurash
dialogues.text: Speaking of her, I was shocked when I met her for the first time!

dialogues.speaker: Kurash
dialogues.text: Appearances do change over time, but I'm certain Granny Jehiet is "The Lioness" in the legend!

dialogues.speaker: Kurash
dialogues.text: I didn't expect her to be living here... and even adopt a little boy.

dialogues.speaker: Kurash
dialogues.text: It's so unbelievable, I mean, she is "The Lioness" after all...
